documents.what_it_proves: Recorded three-page 1977 deed conveys approximately 2.113 acres to City of Columbus for roadway and appurtenant utility purposes. The Columbus 1978 City Bulletin accepted the deed.
documents.limitation_or_missing_record: Deed reserves grantor ingress/egress and contains a conditional repurchase clause if pavement was not widened within five years; current status requires title/road-history review. The source route runs west along Morse to the creek, but its exact offset from the 60-foot south-side strip and proposed work envelope are unsurveyed. Verify later conveyances, roadway construction and permit authority.
